title: The inverse constant ringed tower square is the specified compositor
statement: Let A be a commutative ring and k:V→W, r:V→S, p:W→T, i:S→T a chosen cartesian square. Let κ be the natural isomorphism from G_A(p)⋙G_A(k) to G_A(i)⋙G_A(r), equal to the inverse of gComp(A,k,p), followed by eqToIso(G_A(sq.w)), followed by gComp(A,r,i). Then the inverse natural transformation of exchangeConstantSquare(A,sq).exchangeTowerSquare equals κ.hom. The fixed compositors and constant coefficient transports are those of strict tower operations [def-weil-pbc-strict-tower-operations, def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations, def-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-arrows]. No openness, properness, completeness or boundedness assumption is needed.

source.place: Tags 03D8 and 07A7, composition of module inverse images and its derived base-change square; the finite open-exchange factor of blueprint latest/sec-six-functors-basics/sk-prop-sf-cbc/sk-prop-sf-cbc.proof.md.

proof.text: Identify the constant module pullback compositors with the section-normalized ringed compositors by conjugate uniqueness. The dependent equality of the endpoint coefficient identifications then gives the explicit moduleSquareG formula. Whiskering over the strict tower index and exact localization give the same square as squareG_lift. Reuse the complete existing proof cbcEvaluationConstantTowerSquare from CompleteProetaleStrictTowerRealization; none of that module’s main realization theorem or completed-open claims is applied. The helper uses only these compositor definitions and the explicit moduleSquareG specification. Finally take inverses of that equality. A generic inverse-composite calculation identifies the three factors before taking components. The hypothesis specifying κ then gives the asserted natural-transformation equality.

theorem exchangeConstantTowerSquare_inv (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {V W S T : Scheme.{u}} (k : V ⟶ W) (r : V ⟶ S) (p : W ⟶ T) (i : S ⟶ T)
    (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare k r p i)
    (κ : ProEtale.StrictTower.G A p ⋙ ProEtale.StrictTower.G A k ≅
      ProEtale.StrictTower.G A i ⋙ ProEtale.StrictTower.G A r)
    (hκ : κ = (ProEtale.StrictTower.gComp A k p).symm ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (ProEtale.StrictTower.G A) sq.w) ≪≫
      ProEtale.StrictTower.gComp A r i) :
    (exchangeConstantSquare (A := A) sq).exchangeTowerSquare.inv = κ.hom
